title: GitHub Actions and GitLab CI in practice

videos.script: Lesson 5 built a CI out of a git hook. This lesson writes the same loop for the two services most teams use. {{services}} First GitHub Actions. You will read shipquote's workflow file line by line. A trigger, three jobs, a matrix of six cells, artifacts passed between machines. {{workflow}} That file has never run on GitHub, and the lesson says so. A static checker reads it instead, and catches one typo of the two it is given. {{checker}} Then real runs, of this very repository's workflow, read from GitHub's own records. Which job took longest. Which step failed, and what it stopped. Runs cancelled because a newer push arrived. {{records}} Then the same pipeline for GitLab, and this one does run, in containers, through an emulator of GitLab's runner. {{gitlab}} The lesson ends with a dictionary between the two. Learn the loop once, and look the syntax up. {{dictionary}}
